    def calculate(a, b, op):
        if op == '+':
            return a + b
        elif op == '*':
            return a * b

    def max_value(expr, memo):
        if expr in memo:
            return memo[expr]

        max_val = float('-inf')
        n = len(expr)

        for i in range(1, n, 2):
            left_expr = expr[:i]
            right_expr = expr[i+1:]
            op = expr[i]

            left_value = max_value(left_expr, memo)
            right_value = max_value(right_expr, memo)

            current_value = calculate(left_value, right_value, op)
            max_val = max(max_val, current_value)

        for i in range(3, n, 2):
            for j in range(i+2, n, 2):
                left_expr = expr[:i]
                mid_expr = expr[i:j]
                right_expr = expr[j+1:]
                op1 = expr[i-1]

                left_value = max_value(left_expr, memo)
                mid_value = max_value(mid_expr, memo)
                right_value = max_value(right_expr, memo)

                current_value = calculate(calculate(left_value, mid_value, op1), right_value, op2)
                max_val = max(max_val, current_value)

        memo[expr] = max_val
        return max_val
